_doc: Cryptographic pins for the ccreality inner-actor coding-harness model files. The reality-loop binary loads this file at start-up and refuses to load any GGUF whose size or sha256 does not match the active pin entry. New entries must include all six fields; missing fields fail closed. Recompute sha256 deliberately when intentionally upgrading.

qwen3_coder_30b_a3b_q4_k_xl.description: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, Unsloth Dynamic Q4_K_XL GGUF — Mixture-of-Experts coder-specialized model (30B total params, 3B active per token, ~17.67 GB on-disk). Replaced dense Qwen3.6-27B-Q6_K_XL on 2026-05-08 for ~3-5x speedup at parity coder quality.
